description: R-SQL-1 SQL-B, SQL-REL: What order, Null placement and tie order does ORDER BY give over the S text rows ascending, descending, with a secondary id DESC, over Memo, by Len(t), by output position, when an alias (id AS t) collides with a source field name, and over the N Double column (signed zero, Null)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-mdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
